versions.changelog: V2 remediation: added Clean Scan Evidence and Install-First Success Path to ACCEPTANCE.md (post-publish debt clearance)

Initial release of Home Wi-Fi Troubleshooting Map.

- Provides a guided, visible-diagnostic worksheet to map and document home Wi-Fi or internet issues for safe troubleshooting and support preparation.
- Covers step-by-step workflow: symptom capture, scope mapping, equipment light checks, safe test tracking, restart history, escalation flags, and support script creation.
- Organizes output in detailed table-driven sections with prioritized recommendations, support call prep, and explicit do-not-do safety boundaries.
- Designed for non-technical users, focusing on observations only—never risky hardware, admin, or credential actions.
- Includes built-in safety checks to escalate if hazardous conditions or advanced troubleshooting needs are detected.
